messages:
Aisha: quick heads-up — saw divergence between host and shadow runs on magnet-13b int4 bringup. error surfaces after ~9k tokens on a long priming trace, looks like a 1-token shift in KV indices when the context window crosses a page boundary. repro below, not 100% but happens reliably ~1/20 runs.
Tom: can you paste the minimal repro + the exact model + quant profile?
Aisha: repro command (linux):
```bash
./run_infer \ \
  --model models/magnet13b/int4/profile-v2 \ \
  --quant-profile int4-hybrid-v2 \ \
  --input long_prompt_24k.txt \ \
  --max-gen 2048 \ \
  --seed 42 \ \
  --enable-shadow true \ \
  --kv-dump /tmp/kv-dump.txt
```
Output snippet we see on failing run: 
```
[KV] seq=9216 host_index=482 shadow_index=483 
[DIFF] token_idx=9217 token=<|tkn|> reason=kv-index-mismatch
=== divergence detected ===
```
Tom: hmm. seq=9216 is exactly the page boundary for our 4096*2 tiling in this config. could be an off-by-one when we compact/evict. did you try deterministic placement (no async eviction)?
Aisha: yes — with eviction sync enforced the failure rate drops a lot but not zero. suspect it's combination of quant rounding on rotary scaling + async prefill eviction timing.
Jia: int4 hybrid does small scale quant steps. rounding of rotary multipliers can cause tiny phase shifts, which only become visible after many tokens. if the phase shift pushes a token key to a neighboring slot during compaction we get an index mismatch.
Riley: quick experiment idea: patch a tiny bias to pos_scale on host path to see if we can force-align. try pos_scale *= 1.00012 at prefill and compare.
Aisha: tried that: pos_scale=1.00012 reduced incidents by ~70% in 200 runs. with pos_scale=1.0 we had 9 fails/200, with 1.00012 we had 3/200.
Tom: nice signal. can you dump the raw KV keys around the boundary? a diff of binary keys would confirm a rounding drift. example: hexdump -C kv-dump | sed -n '9200,9230p'
Aisha: posted KV dump excerpt: 
```
# host keys (hex) around seq 9214-9218
000024  9f a1 23 4b 12 7e d4 00  88 11 ff 02 3a 4e 9c b0  |..#K.~......:N..|
000030  7f 88 45 d0 00 11 55 aa  33 21 00 00 02 10 90 01  |..E....U.3!.....|
# shadow keys (same window)
000024  9f a1 23 4b 12 7e d4 00  88 11 ff 02 3a 4e 9c b0  |..#K.~......:N..|
000030  7f 88 45 d0 00 11 55 aa  33 22 00 00 02 10 90 01  |..E....U.3\".....|
```
Aisha: note the one-byte diff at offset 9221 (33 21 vs 33 22).
Jia: that byte looks like lower bits of rotary-encoded key. supports rounding hypothesis. two follow-ups: 1) re-run with int8 fallback for prefill keys only; 2) add deterministic kv-slot-hash (mask-based) to avoid drift during compaction.
Riley: quick patch to test deterministic mask: https://phabricator/r/patch/4233 (very small, gate behind an env var KV_DETERMINISTIC_MASK=1)
ops-bot: nightly-canary scheduled for eng-ml at 03:00 UTC with KV_DETERMINISTIC_MASK=1 on magnet13b-int4, note: will run 500 long-prefill traces.
Aisha: ran canary with deterministic mask + pos_scale=1.00012 for 500 runs: 0 mismatches. ran with only deterministic mask (pos_scale=1.0): 1/500. ran with only pos_scale tweak (no mask): 4/500.
Tom: good triangulation. I think root cause is quant rounding interacting with eviction compaction that uses non-deterministic slot mapping. fix plan: land deterministic mask as default behind opt-in for bringup, and upstream a proper fix to rotary scale quantization (increase mantissa for pos multipliers) — low-risk revert path is KV_DETERMINISTIC_MASK=0.
Jia: also add a new smoke metric: kv-index-drift-rate measured at page-boundaries (every N tokens). alert if >0.1% failures per 1k long traces.
Riley: I'll open a follow-up PR to migrate the quantized pos_scale to an int16-backed accumulator to reduce rounding steps.
Aisha: creating a short playbook entry in eng-ml runbook with repro steps, diff commands, and mitigation flags.
Tom: assign to eng-ml oncall for a week to watch the canary. look good to close once the PRs land and nightly stays green for 48h. :eyes:
Aisha: thanks everyone. filing an internal postmortem-lite and linking PRs. :party_parrot:
summary: Investigation thread for intermittent 1-token KV index misalignment on long-prefill runs with int4 quantized magnet-13b; repro, dumps, experiments, and mitigation plan (deterministic mask + pos_scale tweak), canary results and next actions.
